sections.heading: Combat Rhythm
items: Attack once or twice, then retreat. Enemies have long wind-ups; learn the tells.
Use heavy attacks or running attacks as enemies close distance. They deal more stagger and damage.
Do not hold block continuously. Your block bar drains and breaks, leaving you stunned and vulnerable.
Dodge sideways for melee, backwards for charged attacks. Rolling into an attack is usually fatal early on.

sections.heading: Weapons
items: Cutlass / Sword: balanced speed and range. Good for most enemies.
Axe: slower, high damage, breaks shields well. Best for heavily armored foes.
Pistol: mid-range, great for opening fights or finishing fleeing targets. Keep ammo crafted.
Bow: silent, ammo-efficient. Useful for pulling single enemies from camps.

sections.heading: Boss Tips
items: Set a Tent/Bonfire near the arena. Bosses hit hard, and respawn close prevents long corpse runs.
Eat two buff foods and bring healing items.
Study phase changes. Most bosses add new attacks at ~50% HP.
Summon co-op friends if you are stuck. Windrose scales but extra players make positioning easier.
